meta_description: CBI Heating is your trusted Wolverhampton plumber. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and heating systems. Fast response, fair prices. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Wolverhampton? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle every heating and plumbing need with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Boiler broken down? We diagnose and repair most faults same day. No call-out charge for genuine repairs, and we carry common parts on the van.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New condensing boiler fitted, commissioned, and guaranteed for 5 years. We handle all the paperwork and dispose of your old unit.

services.title: Central Heating System Repair
services.desc: Leaking pipes, airlocked radiators, pump failures — we fix them fast and efficiently. Full system flush available to improve efficiency.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Bleeding
services.desc: Add warmth to any room with new radiators or balance your existing system. We balance all radiators to distribute heat evenly.

services.title: Burst Pipe & Leak Repair
services.desc: Water damage spreads fast. We locate leaks using thermal imaging, make emergency repairs, and prevent costly damage to your home.

services.title: Annual Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating efficient and safe with a yearly Gas Safe service. Includes safety checks, cleaning, and a detailed report.

about_pullquote: I started CBI Heating because I hated seeing families left in the cold with no hot water.
about_para_1: CBI Heating was founded 18 years ago by a qualified plumber who'd had enough of cowboys and unreliable call-outs. We built our reputation on showing up on time, diagnosing problems honestly, and getting the job done right the first time. Today we're Gas Safe registered and trusted by hundreds of Wolverhampton homes and businesses.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is simple: we answer our phone, we don't disappear mid-job, and we quote fair prices upfront. Our customers come back because they know we'll be there when they need us, and they recommend us to their friends. That's the only marketing we do.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About CBI Heating

reviews.text: Boiler died on a Sunday evening in December. Called CBI Heating and they had someone at my door by 8pm. New part fitted, everything working again within two hours. Couldn't ask for better service. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a radiator leak that was dripping into the kitchen. They came out same day, fixed it properly, and explained what had gone wrong. No messing about. Will definitely use them again when my boiler needs servicing.
reviews.author: Christine W.

reviews.text: Really impressed. The lad was knowledgeable, cleaned up after himself, and didn't try to upsell me on things I didn't need. Just a straightforward, honest job. Highly recommend to anyone in Wolverhampton.
reviews.author: David P.
